data.cultural_impact: The name Prkash carries a deep cultural significance in Indian society. It is considered an auspicious and meaningful name, as it represents the brightness and positivity associated with light. In Hinduism, the sojourn of the sun god from east to west is associated with the cycle of life - birth, growth, maturity, decline, and death. Thus, the name Prkash is a symbol of the continuous cycle of life and also of the transformative power of knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Prkash signifies the inner light that illuminates the mind and soul. It signifies the search for truth and knowledge, and the belief that the individual has the potential to overcome the darkness of ignorance. The name Prkash is a reminder of the self-illuminating nature of the Atman (soul) and encourages one to seek enlightenment and spiritual growth. Moreover, as the sun is considered a symbol of the divine, the name Prkash is believed to bless the individual with divine grace and blessings.
